text: Figure 11.34: Security protocol configuration With this modeling approach it is possible to configure different security protocol set- tings for the communication over TCP , UDP and multicast. For example it is allowed to use different settings to protect the TCP communication of a AdaptivePlatform- ServiceInstance via TLS and UDP communication via DTLS. Please note that protection of IP multicast traffic is only supported by SecOC and therefore the ServiceInstanceToMachineMapping refers directly the SecOcSe- cureComProps in the secOcComPropsForMulticast role.
